facts.en: Completed a BA in Social Inquiry at Fictional Willowglass College in 2022.
facts.zh: 2022 年获虚构柳璃学院社会研究文学学士学位。

facts.en: Attended a 2024-02 introductory usability workshop; no professional certification was awarded.
facts.zh: 参加 2024-02 的可用性入门工作坊；未获专业认证。

facts.en: Service desk assistant at Fictional Lantern Desk, 2022-08 to 2024-03.
facts.zh: 2022-08 至 2024-03 在虚构灯笼服务台任服务台助理。

facts.en: Research operations assistant at Fictional Lantern Desk, 2024-04 to 2026-09.
facts.zh: 2024-04 至 2026-09 在虚构灯笼服务台任研究运营助理。

facts.en: Booked remote sessions and tracked participant consent forms using a researcher-approved checklist.
facts.zh: 使用研究员批准的核对表预约远程访谈并跟踪参与者同意书。

facts.en: Coordinated 18 sessions at the 2025-11 peak; the active 2026-09 study had 7 scheduled sessions.
facts.zh: 2025-11 高峰期协调 18 场访谈；2026-09 的在研项目已安排 7 场访谈。

facts.en: Supported a booking-page usability study during 2025-05 to 2025-06; the senior researcher set the questions and recruited the sample.
facts.zh: 2025-05 至 2025-06 支持预订页面可用性研究；高级研究员制定问题并招募样本。

facts.en: Personally took notes in 8 sessions and grouped observation excerpts in a shared affinity board.
facts.zh: 个人在 8 场访谈中记录笔记，并在共享亲和图中归类观察摘录。

facts.en: The team recorded successful task completion in 6 of 8 sessions; the sample was exploratory and not representative of all users.
facts.zh: 团队记录 8 场访谈中有 6 场成功完成任务；样本仅用于探索，不能代表全部用户。

facts.en: Drafted a revised reminder email in 2026-01; it had not been tested or sent by 2026-03.
facts.zh: 2026-01 起草修订后的提醒邮件；截至 2026-03 尚未测试或发送。

facts.en: Uses spreadsheet filters, video-call scheduling, and shared whiteboards.
facts.zh: 使用电子表格筛选、视频会议排期和共享白板。

facts.en: Redacts contact details from exported research notes under the team checklist.
facts.zh: 按照团队核对表隐去导出研究笔记中的联系信息。

facts.en: In 2024-09, created a personal map of 15 fictional walking routes, unrelated to the employer study.
facts.zh: 2024-09 制作包含 15 条虚构步行路线的个人地图，与雇主研究无关。

facts.en: Enjoys paper-cutting and weekend sketching; no commercial illustration work is claimed.
facts.zh: 爱好剪纸和周末素描；不声称商业插画经历。

facts.en: Volunteered at Fictional Seed Swap during 2025-04 weekends while employed full-time.
facts.zh: 2025-04 周末在虚构种子交换活动做志愿者，与全职工作同期。

facts.en: An undated shorthand note says moderator; the signed study log records note-taker, so moderation ownership is unconfirmed.
facts.zh: 一条未注明日期的简写备注称主持人；签字研究日志记为记录员，因此主持责任未经确认。

facts.en: A portfolio screenshot shows an 82% label without a denominator or metric definition; it is not a verified study result.
facts.zh: 一张作品集截图显示 82% 标签，但无分母或指标定义；不是已核实的研究结果。

facts.en: No independent research-plan ownership or statistical hypothesis testing is documented.
facts.zh: 未记录独立负责研究计划或统计假设检验经历。
